title: How often complaints are sustained, and how long they take
question: By the year findings were issued, what share of allegations decided on the merits were sustained, and how long did closed cases take?
finding: Police: 4.4% of allegations decided on the merits were sustained in 2024, 4.0% in 2025 and 2.9% in 2026 to 20 November; the median closed case took 98, 56 and 47 days. Sheriff's Office cases ran slower: median 308 days in 2026, with 9.8% sustained.
how: One row per allegation (latest snapshot), grouped by findings-issued year; case length is the largest case_length_of_investigation_days on the case in its latest snapshot.
limits: Sustained cases go on to a post-investigation stage and close later, so the latest year under-counts them. The files hold only cases closed or open at each download, not every complaint ever made. A lower share can mean weaker cases, a different mix of complaints, or a change in practice; the files do not say which.
